Titulo: Service Status Pay-ins Ecuador | SafetyPay Temporary Unavailability
Resumen:
The service disruption has been confirmed to be affecting SafetyPay payments through Banco Guayaquil exclusively. Payments through other banks are not affected. The situation remains under review, and we expect to provide further updates within the next few hours.
